events.what: Garonzi and Margolis prove the Herzog-Schönheim conjecture for all finite simple groups and all finite symmetric groups
Chouraqui's covering-space approach to coset partitions of free groups (2018 preprint, journal publication April 2024)

judgement.doubts: Garonzi-Margolis relies on GAP/Mathematica computation (computer algebra, not AI) and is still a preprint; scope is a class of finite groups, so partial regardless of review. Chouraqui work predates the snapshot (F7) and is not a resolution; its scope is not assessed in detail since it cannot set status.
